note: City of Ottumwa campground in Greater Ottumwa Park (340 acres of green space and lagoons) near the Des Moines River. Sites run a bit small (a 30-ft trailer fits site 50). The south row of pads looks across the park road and a lawn at the lagoon; the rest sit under trees. No tents in the RV section. --Claude
summary: The city page confirms $22-25 (regular $22, full hookup $25), 87 RV spots (83 + 4 full hookup) plus 5 tent spots, shower house, dump, WiFi, FCFS only, open April 1 to November 1. Waterfront pond -> lakeview (the lagoon is about 5.6 acres and across the park road from the south row). The note's stale $20/$25-from-July-2026, '100+ sites' and 'April-October' were dropped.
flags: WATERFRONT: pond -> lakeview. 'pond' is an on-water value, but on both images the park road runs between every pad and the water. The south lagoon is about 5.6 acres by dark-pixel count on NAIP (more with its weedy fringe and the SW lobe), and the city calls these 'lagoons', so it takes a lake value under the 5-acre rule. On the Esri winter image the south row of pads (~41.0148,-92.4262) looks across the road and an open lawn with scattered trees at the lagoon about 35-45 m away, which is lakeview. The other pads sit under trees 80 m+ back. If the lagoon is judged under 5 acres, this becomes not waterfront (no pond-view value). The west lagoon (~1.8 acres) is a pond 150 m+ away across lawn.

LAWN CAMPER: NAIP shows one trailer parked on the lawn between the road and the lagoon (~41.0144,-92.4268), beside a small paved lot and pier. The city does not say whether that lawn is a camping area (it may be the 5 tent spots or a special-event overflow), so it was not counted toward the waterfront call.

NOTE CORRECTIONS: dropped '$20/night ($25 effective July 1, 2026)' (the page says $22 regular, $25 full hookup), '100+ electric/water sites' (the page counts 83 + 4), 'Open ~April-October' (April 1 to November 1), and the redundant FCFS/dump/shower/WiFi and RV Life text.
UNVERIFIED: the 20-amp electric (derived) and 'sites run a bit small; a 30-ft trailer fits site 50' come from earlier secondary research; the city page gives no amperage or lengths. Left as stored.
